notation: Logical Arabic in the engine notation (engines.ridge_racer): one line, the pad's buttons written as the symbols they draw (△ □ ○, and Ⅱ for the NeGcon's), in the small font only. A string holds Arabic letters, spaces, Western or Arabic-Indic digits and the punctuation . : ! - ، ؛ ؟ (the large font: . : ! -) only. It keeps to its original's room: 20 bytes, two for the hook's header and one for the zero, so 17 glyphs, a glyph being a letter's form, a space, a digit or a sign. The hook centres the text on the English, or ends it where the English's mirror ends; it must stay on the 320-pixel screen. No vowel marks: the fonts have none.

entries.context: The title screen's blinking prompt to press the Start button (small font, centred)
The main menu's help line with the pad: the triangle or the square button goes back (small font, centred; the game draws it again a pixel lower right as a shadow)
The title of the memory card screen that loads the fastest laps (large chrome font, ending on the right)
